_comment: Checked against the official AWS Price List API (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<AmazonS3|AmazonDynamoDB|awskms|AWSDataTransfer>/current/<region>/index.json) on 2026-11-11. On-demand list prices in USD, first pricing tier (S3 Standard first 50 TB; DynamoDB storage beyond the 25 GB free tier; data transfer out beyond the 100 GB/month global free tier). Free tiers are not subtracted. Used by pc_tools/storage_benchmark.py; re-check before quoting and update verified_on.
